input.free_text_description: This system is a user management platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for global exception handler, address, user. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to interact with address functionality, so that I can accomplish my address-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with address integration test support functionality, so that I can accomplish my address integration test support-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use global exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use address capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
